//: Copy to config.system.json and edit. Every setting is optional.
// paths: Absolute (D:/vocal/n.wav or /home/me/vocal/n.wav) or relative to this file (vocal/n.wav).
// check: Run `mediaconductor doctor` to see what each path resolved to. Reference: docs/setup.md

tts.//: Narrator voice. speaker_wav = a clean 10-30s sample to clone. No file means Kokoro.

bgm.//: Music bed. Set file for one track, or directory to use the first track in it.

download_defaults.//: MangaDex fetch. Leave download_delay alone - the politeness spacing is deliberate.

manga_video.//: Keep audio_source 'faded'. Raw clip edges click; 'raw' is for diagnosis only.

cut_page.//: Panel reading order, used only when the source language is unknown.

paths.//: Renames data/library/ if you want a different folder name.
